:::{#exr-extend-basis-practice}
#### Extending one vector to a basis of $\reals^3$

@thm-extend-basis says that any [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent) list
can be completed to a [basis](#def-basis).
Let

$$
\vecf{v}_1 = \sbmat{1 \\ 1 \\ 0}.
$$

Find two [indicator vectors](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-indicator-vector) that extend $\vecf{v}_1$ to a basis of $\reals^3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Add [indicator vectors](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-indicator-vector) one at a time,
each outside the [span](#def-span) of the list so far,
as @thm-add-outside-span allows.

:::

:::
